PRACTITIONER TOOLKIT

Acceptance Criteria & Gherkin Generator

As a Senior BA, defining bulletproof acceptance criteria prevents scope churn and guarantees frictionless UAT. Use this interactive sandbox to generate standardized Given-When-Then test cases and SMART criteria for your future projects.

G
Given (Pre-conditions)
Initial contextual state, user authentication, or data prerequisites.
W
When (Business Action)
Trigger event, user action, batch job, or system integration call.
T
Then (Deterministic Outcome)
Testable observable result, database update, notifications, or audit event.

          How to Customize & Deploy This Portfolio
        

        
      


      

        

          
1. ADDING YOUR REAL-WORLD PROJECTS

          

            Use the + Add Project button to populate your own project details, deliverables, and metrics. Data persists automatically in your browser's localStorage.
          

        


        

          
2. EXPORTING & BACKING UP (JSON)

          

            Click Export Projects JSON at any time to download your customized project portfolio. You can copy this data directly into the default projects array inside the HTML file for a static build!
          

        


        

          
3. HOSTING ON GITHUB PAGES OR NETLIFY

          

            This file is completely self-contained with no server dependencies. Simply rename the file to index.html and push it to a GitHub repository or drag-and-drop into Netlify Drop / Cloudflare Pages.
          

        


        

          
4. PRINT TO PDF / RESUME COMPANION

          

            The portfolio is styled with responsive CSS print profiles. You can trigger browser print (Ctrl/Cmd + P) to generate a formatted PDF portfolio dossier to attach to job applications.
